title: Low-slope roofs.
officialText:
For roof slopes from 2½ units vertical in 12 units horizontal (21-percent slope), up to four
units vertical in 12 units horizontal (33-percent slope), underlayment shall be a minimum of two layers applied as follows:
1. Starting at the eave, a 19-inch (483 mm) strip of underlayment shall be applied parallel with the eave and fastened
sufficiently in place.
2. Starting at the eave, 36-inch-wide (914 mm) strips of underlayment felt shall be applied overlapping successive
sheets 19 inches (483 mm) and fastened sufficiently in place.
